model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the satisfaction levels with five different aspects of a tool, as indicated by participant responses to a survey. The horizontal axis displays the aspects evaluated – “range of explanations,” “veracity explanations,” “most features,” “recall checks,” and “overall usability” – listed in this order, with no explicit sorting apparent. The vertical axis, labeled “% satisfied,” presents a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at 20% intervals. Five bars are present, each corresponding to one of the aspects listed on the horizontal axis, all bars are the same color (dark gray) and their heights represent the percentage of participants reporting satisfaction. “Recall checks” received the highest satisfaction rating, measuring 80%. The lowest satisfaction rating was for “range of explanations” with a value of 30%. “Overall usability” and “veracity explanations” both showed approximately 60% satisfaction. “Most features” showed approximately 50% satisfaction. No bars are visually distinguished through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
